name: One Last Salty Kiss
source:
"Would you rather lose your past,
or live with the pain it caused?"

After getting out of a broken relationship, Michele escapes from his daily life to the beach, in the hopes of clearing the burdens of his past.

But there he will meet Azzurra, a girl who lost her memory. Helping her get it back will prove more difficult than expect, testing what caring about someone truly means...
